card.name: The V in Nausea and Vomiting
card.fires_on: The split-off letter V in "Nausea and V|omiting", mainly in dosing headings for chemotherapy-induced or postoperative nausea. Rarely, other word-start pieces such as FREE in "DO NOT FREEZE" or an opening parenthesis after "consciousness".

modes.label: V in vomiting
modes.description: The letter V that begins the split word "Vomiting" after "Nausea and" or "Nausea and/or" in section headings and table titles.
